title: Applied labs
description: Build, break, debug and evaluate in your own environment.

lessons.title: Lab: Specifications & repository context
lessons.conceptOverview: Write a specification for a parser with malformed-input behavior. Give the assistant a failing example and inspect which files its patch changes.
lessons.whyItMatters: Specify, inspect and verify AI-generated changes.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Give a coding assistant acceptance criteria, relevant interfaces and repository conventions. Scope context to the problem while keeping secrets out. A specification should state observable behavior and edge cases. Ask for a concrete patch and evidence rather than assuming a plausible explanation means correct code.

sections.title: 1. Establish a baseline
sections.content: Write down your inputs, expected behavior and constraints before starting. Write a specification for a parser with malformed-input behavior. Give the assistant a failing example and inspect which files its patch changes.

sections.title: 2. Introduce a failure
sections.content: Test the mistaken assumption: A convincing explanation proves a generated patch is correct. Record the observed result and the point where it diverges from your prediction.

sections.title: 3. Debug and evaluate
sections.content: Use the mechanism to explain the failure: Give a coding assistant acceptance criteria, relevant interfaces and repository conventions. Scope context to the problem while keeping secrets out. A specification should state observable behavior and edge cases. Ask for a concrete patch and evidence rather than assuming a plausible explanation means correct code. Change one variable at a time. Repeat the baseline and add a held-out case. Submit the implementation, results and limitations.

commonMistakes: A convincing explanation proves a generated patch is correct.
keyTakeaways: Give a coding assistant acceptance criteria, relevant interfaces and repository conventions.

lessons.title: Lab: Debugging, tests & review
lessons.conceptOverview: Ask for a fix to a failing boundary case, then test empty, malformed and oversized inputs. Identify a test that merely repeats the implementation and replace it.
lessons.whyItMatters: Specify, inspect and verify AI-generated changes.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Reproduce the failure before editing. Use tests that exercise observable behavior and can fail for a plausible incorrect implementation. Review generated code for injection, authorization, error handling and dependency risks. Refactoring should preserve behavior, verified with regression checks.

lessons.title: Lab: Agentic coding & Git workflows
lessons.conceptOverview: Run a small specification-driven change in an isolated checkout. Review the diff, run relevant tests and write a rollback plan before merging.
lessons.whyItMatters: Specify, inspect and verify AI-generated changes.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Coding agents can plan and execute multi-step changes, but need a bounded task and reviewable diffs. Isolated branches or worktrees reduce collisions. Check repository status before edits, preserve unrelated changes and review generated commands before destructive operations. Evaluate task completion using behavior and maintainability.
